title: גאה
content:
[Str1342] גאה (prob. √ of foll.; BH גָּאָה rise up).

[Str1344,1467] † גֵּוָה n. f. pride (Targum גֵּיוָה; BH גֵּאָה; cf. K§ 55, l (but also 6 a));—abs. ´בְּג: Dn 4:34 in pride.

[Str1355,1354] † [גַּב] n. [m.] either back (Targum גַּב back, top; BH גַּב, √ גנב), or < side (√ גנב, cf. Ar. جَنْبٌ side, Syr. ܓܒܐ side, √ ܓܢܒ;—v. also DWB 65);—pl. sf. Dn 7:6 Kt wings עַל־גַּבַּיהּ on its sides (Bev Behrm Dr; Qr גַּבַּהּ perh. its back, so most).

[Str1358,1359] † [גֹּב] n. m. pit, den of lions (Targum גּוּב, Syr. ܓܘܒ pit;? cf. BH גֹּב n.pr.loc., √ גבב);—cstr. ´ג: Dn 6:8, 6:25; גּוֺב v:13; emph. גֻּבָּא v:17, v:18, v:20, v:21, v:24, v:24, v:25.

title: גבר
content:
[Str1396] גבר (√ of foll.; be strong, so Targum; BH גָּבַר).

[Str1399–400] גְּבַר:21 n. m. man (BH);—abs. ´נ: Dn 2:25 5:11; pl. abs. גֻּבְרִין (K§ 54, 3 e) 3:24, 3:25, also, = certain ones, v:8, v:12, v:20; emph. גֻּבְרַיָּא Ezr 4:21, 5:4, 5:10, 6:8, Dn 3:12 + 9 t. Dn.

[Str1370] † [גְּבוּרָה] n. f. might;—emph. גְּביּרְתָּא (K§ § 9 c): 57 b) a) but M§ 72 c) Dn 2:20, 2:23.

[Str1401] † [גִּבָּר] n. m. mighty one;—pl. cstr. חַיִל גִּבָּרֵ־י Dn 3:20 (= BH גִּבּוֺרֵי חַיִל).

[Str1411] ‡ † דְָֽבְרַיָּא n. m. pl. emph. Dn 3:2, 3:3, dub.: most think ‖ form of [גַּזְבָּר] treasurer (or, MeyEntst. J. 23, text. err. for ´גז:); Gr Bev al. rd. הַדָּֽבְרַיָּא ministers (3:24); poss. (v. Lag Dr al.) dittogr. for following דְּתָֽבְרַיָּא.

title: גַּו
content: [Str1459] † [גַּו] n. m. midst (Eg. Aram. Nab. Palm. גו; Targum גָּיו; esp. cstr. בְּגוֺ, לְגוֺ, מִגּוֺ; so Syr. ܓܘ; cf. BH נֵּו, p. 156);—cstr. גּוֺא (so Nab. CookeNo. 94) Dn 3:26 +, 7:15 edd., Gi גּוֺ (Baer גּוֺא, v. on 3:6); sf. 3 ms. גַּוֵּהּ † Ezr 5:7, 3 fs. גַּוַּהּ † 4:15, 6:2;—midst, alw. c. preps.: a. בְּגוֺא (= Heb. בְּתוֺךְ), Dn 3:25 בְּגוֺא גוּרָא, 4:7, 7:15, Ezr 4:15; 5:7 וְכִדְנָה כְּ תִיב בְּגַוֵהּ, 6:2. b. לְגוֺא Dn 3:6, 3:11, 3:15, 3:21, 3:23, 3:24. c. מִן־גּוֺא Dn 3:26.

title: גֵּרָה
content:
[Str1467] גֵּרָה v. גאה

[Str1490,1489,1411] † [גִּזְבָּר] n. m. treasurer (Pers. loan-word (Scheft81); Targum Syr. BH; K§ 64:3; in Bab. ganzabaru PeiserZAW xvii (1897). 347);—pl. emph. גִּזְבָּרַיָּא Ezr 7:21.—Vid. גְּדָֽבְרַיָּא. above

title: גְּזַר
content:
[Str1505,1504] † [גְּזַר] vb. cut, (divide,) determine (so Targum Syr., in both mngs.; BH usu. divide, † Jb Est decree);—Pe. Pt. act. as subst., pl. abs. גָּֽזְרִין determiners (of fate; astrologers or soothsayers) Dn 2:27, 5:11; emph. גָּֽזְרַיָּא 4:4, 5:7 (cf. Dr.; Ar. جزّار RSJPhil. xiii (1885), 781). Hithpe. Pf. 3 fs. הִתְגְּזֶרֶת 2:34 a stone was cut out, so ´אִתְג: (K§ § 23, 1; 30, 2) v:45 (c. מִן of source).

[Str1510] † [גְּזֵרָה] n. f. decree (Targum גְּזֵירָא, Syr. ܓܙܝܪܐ);—cstr. גְּזֵרַת Dn 4:14, 4:21.

title: גין
content:
[Str5085] † [גין] c. בְּ, בְּגִין prep. on account of (so Galil. Aram., D§ 47:3), read perh. in 7:15: v. נִדְגֵה. p. 1102

[Str1528,1615] † [גִּיר] n. [m.] chalk, plaster (so Targum; BH once, p. 162);—emph. גִּירָא Dn 5:5.

[Str1535] [גַּלְגַּל] v. גלל. below

title: גְּלָא
content:
[Str1540–41] † [גְּלָא, גְּלָה] vb. reveal (BH גָּלָה uncover, reveal);—Pe. reveal secrets, human agent: Inf. לְמִגְלֵא Dn 2:47; of God, Pt. act. גָּלֵא v:22, v:28, v:29, v:47. Pₑ‘îl Pf. גֲּלִי v:19, גֱּלִי v:30, revealed (WCG 225 NöLCB, 1896, 703);—of secret, c. ל Pers. Haph. take into exile (BH Hiph.), Pf. 3 ms. הַגְלִי, c. acc. Pers. Ezr 4:10, 5:12 (ל loc.).

[Str1547,1473] † [גָּלוּ K§ 61. 4] n. f. exile;—emph. בְּגֵי גָלוּתָא i.e. exiles, Ezr 6:16, Dn 2:25, 5:13, 6:14 (cf. BH גּוֺלָה).

title: גלל
content:
[Str1556] גלל (√ of following; BH II. גלל; Palm. גללא Lzb250 SAC36 Cooke334, = στήλη λιθίνη).

[Str1560] † גְּלָל n. [m.] rolling;—abs. ´אֶבֶן ג: Ezr 5:8, 6:4 stones of rolling, too heavy for carrying.

[Str1535] † [גַּלְגַּל] n. m. wheel (Targum BH; Syr. ܓܝܓܠ);—pl. sf. גַּלְגִּלּוֺהִ֫י Dn 7:9 of throne-chariot of God.

[Str4039–40] † מְגִלָּה n. f. (book-) roll (Targum BH);—Ezr 6:2.

title: גְּמַר
content:
[Str1585,1584] † [גְּמַר] vb. complete (oft. Targum Syr.; rare BH);—Pe. Pt. pass. גְּמִיר Ezr 7:12 as adj. perfect (read perh. ´שְׁלָם ג:, Torrey Berthol; cf. 5:7).

[Str1595–96] † [גְּנַז] n. m.:Ezr 6:1 treasure (Targum; v. BH [גְּנָזִים], sub גנז);—pl. emph. גִּנְזִיָּא treasures Ezr 6:1, דִּי מַלְכָּא בֵּית ´ג: 5:17, cstr. בֵּית גִּנְזֵי מִלְכָּא 7:20.

[Str1611,102] † [גַּף] n. f.: Dn 7:4 wing of bird (Targum גַּף, גַּפְּא, גַּנְפָּא (? DWB 79), Syr. ܓܦܐ; akin to BH אֲגַף, As. aggapu ? acc. to NöM 77 (cf. Mand. גאדפא, Targum גַּדְפָּא), IdGGA, 1884, 1019, √ גִדף, Ar. جَدَفَ, جَدَفَ fly, row (but this loan-word Frä227));—pl. abs. wings, גַּפִּין Dn 7:4, 7:6; sf. גַּפִּיהּ v:4 Kt (Qr sg. נַּפַּהּ).

[Str1634–35] † [גְּרַם] n. [m.] bone (BH גֶּ֫רֶם; Chr-Pal. ܓܪܡ SchulthLex. 46);—pl. sf. גַּרְמֵיהוֺן Dn 6:25.

[Str1653,1655] † [גְּשֵׁם] n. m.:Dn 4:30 body (v. √ גשׁם in BH; TargumJ גּוּשְׁמָא, גִּשְׁמָא (DWB 83), Syr. ܓܘܫܡܐ, body, self);—body of man, sf. גִּשְׁמֵהּ Dn 4:30, 5:21, so pl. sf. גַּשְׁמַיהוֺן (K§ 15 a) 3:27, 3:28, both Kt, Qr sg. גֶּשְׁמֵהוֺן (K§ 54, 3 b)).
